name: sim_targeting_walk_matches_scan
description: Stage 5's faster look along the road picks the same creep as a scan of every creep (M4's sim_bench work): with the creeps sorted furthest first once a tick (SimMatch.by_distance), each tower walks them and its own stretches of road together and takes the first in reach. Four caretaken seats fight waves 5 and 6 of High Water, Duskmoths among them, with a knot of creeps held at exactly one distance (ground and winged, so ties must go to the lower id); on every tick, for every tower, the walk and the scan agree, for any creep and for fliers only, and the client probed between ticks keeps every hash of a second client left alone.

steps.eval: [scene.spawn('gourdling', knot), scene.spawn('duskmoth', knot), scene.spawn('scuttler', knot), scene.spawn('duskmoth', knot), scene.spawn('thornback', knot)]

steps.msg: with five creeps at one distance, ground and winged, the walk picks what the scan picks
and through the waves on, every tick, every tower
looking from outside stage 5 changes nothing: the probed client 1 and the untouched client 2 agree

steps.assert: scene.config['walk_checks'] > 50000 and scene.events_where('HIT', {'creep': ids[0]}).size() > 0 and scene.events_where('HIT', {'creep': ids[1]}).size() > 0
steps.msg: (tens of thousands of comparisons, the knot in reach of towers that see the ground and the sky)
